## Summary

F003 (repo onboarding managed block) is complete in the working tree. The `repo_onboarding.py` module implements a reusable managed-block writer with stable HTML-comment markers embedding the generator version and a SHA-256 content hash, plus pure `plan_onboarding`/`apply_onboarding` helpers so the dry-run preview can never drift from real writes. It creates `.dontpanic/dontpanic.json` with explicit schema-compatible defaults (not bare `{}`), creates or surgically updates the generated DontPanic brief block in `AGENTS.md` and a pointer block in `CLAUDE.md`, preserves all content outside the markers byte-for-byte, rewrites only stale blocks (by version/hash) while leaving fresh ones untouched, and warns when only a lowercase `.claude.md` exists. The `dontpanic projects add NAME PATH --onboard [--dry-run] [--json]` flags are wired in `cli.py` for both the apply and preview paths with shared human/JSON rendering. All 17 targeted tests in `test_f003_repo_onboarding.py`
